messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: detected sustained QPS spike for org 'hydra' (org_id=org-6723). 90th latency rising, deploys unaffected. Auto-throttle engaged at 60% but errors increasing. paging maya (oncall) +sre
Maya (oncall): saw the alert. pulling up dashboards now. marking incident Sev2. joining Zoom
Leo (sre): I'm here. can you paste the query? I see a lot of short requests with heavy context windows, looks client-side batching gone wrong.
Maya (oncall): confirmed - tail of requests show 15-30x increase in tokens per request. Traffic from a handful of API keys tied to hydra. customer impact: ~15% requests 429-ing and some 504s at edge.
Ankur (eng-runtime): can we do a targeted override for hydra org? runbook step: temp-org-rl-override -> set per-org p50/p95 limits or disable large-window feature.
Priya (product_oncall): I talked to Nina in cust-succ, hydra says they have a background job misconfigured and are rolling back but need breathing room. they requested temporary bump or soft-queue.
Nina (cust-succ): hydra on call confirms they're reverting the batch job, ETA ~12-15m. asking for minimal disruption to paying endpoints.
Maya (oncall): options: 1) raise org quota 2) patch routing to fallback cheaper model 3) set dynamic rate-limit exception (with hard cap) 4) disable streaming for that org. prefer minimal blast radius: try dynamic exception with strict cap + log.
Leo (sre): agree. I'll do a controlled override: increase org burst to 2x for 10 minutes then auto-drop. also add request sampling for failed calls.
Ankur (eng-runtime): prepping commands. execute via opsctl. snippet: ```
# grant temporary org exception
opsctl rl override set --org org-6723 --mode soft --qps 6 --burst 20 --expires 10m --note "emergency hydra bump 2156789012"
# attach fallback rule
opsctl route add --org org-6723 --when "token_count>512" --to model-llama-quant --weight 0.25
```
Maya (oncall): run it when ready. make sure audit log gets an annotation.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered: opsctl-rl-override v1 -> staged -> success (job 8842)
Ankur (eng-runtime): ran override, audit id audit-8842, metadata attached. also added sampling rule. outputs: "override_applied: true, expires_in: 9m40s"
Leo (sre): monitoring. p50/p95 latency dropping, 429s reducing. edge 504s still trickling but trending down.
Nina (cust-succ): hydra reports error rate down from ~22% to ~3% for paid endpoints. they're continuing rollback. grateful. :pray:
Priya (product_oncall): nice. set follow-up: 1) notify billing if any quota anomalies 2) postmortem to include root cause (client batching) 3) discuss adding a guard to detect sudden token-count increases per API key.
Maya (oncall): agree. scheduling handoff: Leo will own the mitigation for the next 30m, I'm handing off rotation. leaving notes in incident tracker. tagging for postmortem: @eng-runtime, @sre, @product, @cust-succ.
Leo (sre): took handoff. override set to auto-expire; I'll revoke early if hydra back to normal.
Maya (oncall): thanks team. incident resolving to monitoring. will file follow-up and retrospective. :white_check_mark:
